pages.text: The clouds had been gathering all morning, but <name> and his classmates didn’t mind — today was the big school picnic at the village park! Just as they laid out their colorful mats and unpacked their lunchboxes, the first heavy drops of rain began to fall.
“Run!” shouted <name>, as the monsoon opened in full swing. The smell of wet earth rose in the air, and puddles formed everywhere, reflecting the bright umbrellas bobbing like floating boats.

<name> grabbed a large tarpaulin from the picnic shed and led a group of friends to a sheltered grove of trees. Together, they lifted the mats and food onto dry patches, but the real challenge came when they saw Rohan stuck in a deep puddle with his lunchbox floating away!

Thinking quickly, <name> balanced on a fallen log to reach him, guiding Rohan safely across while other friends held hands to form a chain. Laughter and splashes filled the air as everyone worked together, dodging sudden gusts and leaping over puddles.

By the time the rain slowed to a drizzle, all the picnic baskets were safe, and the children sat under the leafy canopy, dripping wet but beaming with pride. The monsoon had tried to ruin their day, but teamwork, clever thinking, and bravery had turned it into the most memorable adventure ever.

<name> looked around at his friends, smiling through raindrops. He realized that even when the skies poured, courage and cooperation could turn a rainy day into a treasure of laughter, stories, and friendship.
